caption: The drawing depicts a single ornate spur, positioned horizontally on a plain, light beige background. The main body of the spur is colored in shades of metallic silver and muted gold, with the heel band featuring a floral and leaf motif in tones of brown, gold, and light reddish-brown, accented with small metallic elements. The rowel (the rotating, star-shaped wheel at the end) is rendered in dark metallic gray with a central silver hub, having multiple evenly spaced long points radiating outward. The shank connecting the rowel to the body of the spur is also metallic, decorated with engraved, swirling patterns. The overall composition places the spur slightly right of center, with no additional objects or significant background details.
title: Spur
